prompt:
Dublin Ltd is taking out a leasing agreement for five years. Dublin must pay £24,000 at the beginning of the first year as a deposit, to be followed by four equal payments at the beginning of years two, three, four and five. At a discount rate of 10%, the present value of the four equal payments is £63,590.

The total amount to be paid during the lease period is:

	£112,258
	£104,240
	£96,380
	£87,590
judge_reasoning: Prompt asks for the total nominal amount paid over a 5-year lease (deposit plus four equal beginning-year payments), given the PV of those four payments is £63,590 at 10%. Candidate 1’s final answer matches the correct option (£104,240) but its derivation has multiple incorrect intermediate steps and inconsistent calculations. Candidates 2 and 3 produce the wrong totals/option (£87,590 and £96,380). Candidate 4 is internally inconsistent/truncated and ends by giving £18,239.34 (a payment amount) instead of the requested total, so its committed answer is incorrect.
